title: Waiver
description: Record that explicitly accepts specific findings of one validation report for one action on pinned artifact revisions, for a limited time (design decision ADR-016 §6). A waiver applies to a finding in a gate only if it is listed by the gate, names the finding's report and finding, has the gate's action and target set, is valid at the gate's evaluation time ('createdAt' ≤ evaluatedAt < 'expiresAt'), and the profile's waiver policy allows the finding's severity. Findings of severity 'critical' are never waivable.

documentType.description: Document type discriminator of a waiver.

schemaVersion.description: Full SemVer of the standard release this document was written against.

createdAt.description: UTC time from which the waiver is valid.

expiresAt.description: UTC time at which the waiver stops applying; must be after 'createdAt' (D2P-SEM-101).

targetRefs.description: Pinned artifact revisions the waiver applies to, sorted by artifactId, revisionId.

action.description: Gate action the waiver applies to.

reportId.description: Validation report containing the waived findings.

findingIds.description: Waived findings of that report, as a sorted set.

justification.description: Reason why the findings are accepted.

approvedBy.description: Actor who approved the waiver (no personal data).

grantId.description: Opaque identifier of the resource grant authorizing the waiver.

contentDigest.description: Optional digest of this whole document in canonical form, excluding 'contentDigest' itself.

extensions.description: Optional extension blocks keyed by extension namespace.
